channel.title: Security Brief
channel.description: Original analysis and ranked cybersecurity news with links to original sources

item.title: The edge is where attackers get in: this week's firewall, VPN and remote-access exploits
item.description: Five exploited flaws in firewalls, VPNs, remote-support software and file-sharing servers show one pattern. The systems that sit at the edge of your network, and that administrators manage remotely, are the weakest link. Here is what to check first.

item.title: Patch Tuesday notes: what the October 2026 Microsoft feed means for you
item.description: The feed shows one new CVE, one unfixed .NET remote code execution issue, and several revisions that need no action. Here is how to read each entry and what to do.

item.title: Weekly M365 & Entra Briefing: 13 to 19 October 2026
item.description: Exchange sign-in problems after October Windows Server updates, an identity-based incident at ConnectWise that affected Microsoft 365 tenants, and why device-code abuse is still worth a Conditional Access check.

item.title: BeyondTrust Remote Support Zero-Day Continues Trend of Exploited Edge Bugs
item.description: Ivanti, Cisco, and Palo Alto Networks all had vulnerabilities in edge devices come under fire this week. Now BeyondTrust joins the group.

item.title: China-Linked Hackers Use ARTEX AI Agents in ConnectWise Supply Chain Attack
item.description: Microsoft on Wednesday disclosed that a China state-aligned actor dubbed Storm-0940 was behind the recent supply chain compromise of the ConnectWise Cloud Backup application. During the incident, Storm-0940 used ARTEX, a Go-based agentic AI penetration testing framework that was made closed-source in the wake of its…

item.title: PHP2Shell Patches Land as First Exploitation Attempts Hit Sensors
item.description: Several cybersecurity companies saw exploitation attempts of CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 before PHP released the patches. The post PHP2Shell Patches Land as First Exploitation Attempts Hit Sensors appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.description: Palo Alto Networks has disclosed that it's continuing to observe exploitation of a now-patched security flaw impacting PAN-OS and Prisma Access by ransomware actors. item.title: 'PHP2Shell' Bugs Signal Red Alert for Security Industry
item.description: Security teams are scrambling to remediate two critical PHP vulnerabilities following leaked details and reports of exploitation attempts.

item.title: CISA: SafePay ransomware hit over 600 critical infrastructure orgs
item.description: The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) says the SafePay ransomware gang has breached over 600 critical infrastructure organizations worldwide since 2024.

item.description: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Tuesday added four vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, including four vulnerabilities impacting Plex Media Server that's collectively called Plex2Shell. item.description: Unknown threat actors breached TeamUpdraft's website and potentially gained unauthorized access to customers' connection keys for UpdraftCentral, UpdraftVault, and UpdraftClone, using them to backdoor WordPress sites. TeamUpdraft is the developer behind UpdraftPlus, a popular WordPress backup plugin with over four…

item.title: State Bank of India Confirms Data Leak After 3,897 Customer Records Found on Dark Web
item.description: State Bank of India has identified 3,897 customer records containing personal information in a set of about 375,000 records available on the dark web, and it does not yet know where the data came from. The state-owned bank, India's largest, said in a stock-exchange filing dated October 21 that it "has experienced an…

item.title: ClickFix Attackers Exploit Siemens Software Center Flaw to Deploy Remote Access Trojan
item.description: Siemens has addressed a DLL sideloading vulnerability impacting Siemens Software Center that it said has been exploited in ClickFix attacks. The high-severity vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-110936 (CVSS v4 score: 8.4), could allow an attacker to place a specially-crafted DLL in a directory the application…

item.title: TiDB Breach Exposes Flawed Cloud Security Assumptions
item.description: Cloud providers may be storing sensitive customer data, without either party knowing it. But when a provider is breached, the data comes home to roost.

item.title: Marvell, Microsoft & Oracle Work to Standardize Data Center Hardware Security
item.description: The effort is aimed at standardizing a NIST FIPS 140-3 Level 3 integrated HSM for cloud and hyperscale data center infrastructure.

item.title: PHP says AI review of critical bugs first sparked alarm in August, but signs surfaced in 2024
item.description: In a lengthy statement about two critical vulnerabilities, the PHP Foundation explained how one dated to 2024, how a recent third-party review by AI companies heightened attention on both, why it scrambled to post information earlier than planned.

item.title: High-Severity Flaws Exploited in Three Days as Ransomware Dominates Q3: Rapid7
item.description: Rapid7’s Q3 analysis finds high-severity flaws exploited within three days on average, while AI appeared in just 8% of tracked incidents. The post High-Severity Flaws Exploited in Three Days as Ransomware Dominates Q3: Rapid7 appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.title: Stolen UpdraftCentral keys used to backdoor WordPress sites
item.description: A threat actor breached TeamUpdraft's website, a developer of popular WordPress backup and security plugins, potentially compromising UpdraftCentral connection keys that can send commands to connected websites.

item.title: FBI says SafePay ransomware gang ‘among most active’ with more than 600 victims since 2024
item.description: The FBI and cyber agencies in the UK and Germany said SafePay is targeting businesses and critical infrastructure by guessing passwords, exploiting vulnerabilities and using phishing attacks.

item.title: Google Chrome adds Gemini-powered scam detection, warns users of ClickFix attacks
item.description: Chrome is getting new scam protections that use Gemini to detect deceptive websites and warn users when they copy suspicious commands from ClickFix attacks.

item.description: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) is warning that attackers are actively exploiting four vulnerabilities in Plex Media Server.

item.title: Decades-Old Windows Utility Powers Modern ClickFix Attack
item.description: The attack uses malicious Google search results related to Amazon and leverages the "finger" utility to launch a CAPTCHA that installs malware, including the Lumma stealer.

item.title: Microsoft PowerToys adds CursorHide, Button Lock mouse tools

item.title: Microsoft says October updates didn’t actually fix VPN issues
item.description: Microsoft says it mistakenly flagged a bug causing Always On VPN connection issues as fixed in the October 2026 Windows 11 cumulative updates.
